about: Three bays, a hoist in each, and the same two people who will be here next year. We work on most makes, petrol and diesel, and we will say so plainly when a job is better done by a dealer.
Nothing gets replaced without a phone call first. If the estimate changes once the wheel is off, you hear about it before the part is ordered, not on the invoice.

faq.q: Do you work on my make?
faq.a: Most makes, petrol and diesel. Ring with the year and model and we will tell you straight.
Weekdays from eight, and Saturday mornings until two.

faq.q: Will you call before doing extra work?
faq.a: Every time. Nothing gets replaced that you have not agreed to first.

faq.q: Can I wait while it is done?
faq.a: For short jobs, yes. There is a seat, a kettle and a view of the bays.
